lines.japanese: さっきから遊んでばっかの気もするけど、そろそろ二度目の休憩時間だな。
lines.english: It felt as though I'd done nothing but fool around all evening, yet my second break was almost upon me.

lines.japanese: はぁー、疲れたぁー、早く休みてぇー。
lines.english: Haaah, I'm beat. God, I need a break.

lines.japanese: 「なあんて弱音は吐かずに、まだまだお仕事がんばるぞう！」
lines.english: “—is the sort of weakness you'll never hear from me! Plenty of work left! Let's give it our all!”

lines.japanese: なぜ俺が急に背筋を伸ばしてハッスルしだしたかと言えば、向こうから玉泉トレーナーがやってきたからです。
lines.english: Why had I suddenly straightened my spine and thrown myself into my work with such vigor? Because Coach Tamaizumi was coming this way.

lines.japanese: 「千歳さん、そろそろ休憩――」
lines.english: “Mr. Chitose, it is nearly time for your break—”

lines.japanese: 「──っ！　いらっしゃいませ」
lines.english: “—! Welcome.”

lines.japanese: 日和子さんがなにか言いかけたところで入口のドアが開きました。いま言いかけた感じだと、このお客様の御案内が済んだら休憩時間をいただけそうです。
lines.english: The front door opened just as Hiyoko began to speak. Judging by the start of that sentence, once we had seated this customer, my break would be mine.

lines.japanese: やる気度、俄然急上昇。俺は日和子さんよりも先に前へ出ました。
lines.english: My motivation shot through the roof. I stepped forward ahead of Hiyoko.

lines.japanese: 「いらっしゃいませ、おひとり様……って、わおカケル君かあ！」
lines.english: “Welcome! A table for one... Oh, look who it is—Kakeru!”

lines.japanese: 御来店は数日ぶりの常連さんでした。よし、そんじゃさっさと座らせて、休憩時間は彼にマスターの昔話でもしてもらおう。
lines.english: Our regular had returned after several days away. Good. I'd seat him quickly, then make him entertain me on my break with stories of the boss's past.

lines.japanese: 「さあさあ神出鬼没のマイフレンド、アレキサンダーへようこそ。どうぞ？　特別席をご用意してございますわよ？」
lines.english: “Come, come, my elusive friend! Welcome to Alexander. Right this way. A special table awaits you.”

lines.japanese: 俺がいつもの調子で声をかけたとき、カケル君はまだ不思議そうな顔をしていました。
lines.english: When I greeted him in my customary fashion, Kakeru was still staring at me as though confronted by a mystery.

lines.japanese: 「……誰おまえ」
lines.english: “...Who are you?”

lines.japanese: 「は？　え、なに？」
lines.english: “What? Huh?”

lines.japanese: それは普段のカケルくんよりずっと不機嫌そうな声でしたが、まあなにせ彼ですからそういう日もあろうと、俺はいつも通りの対応をしました。
lines.english: His voice was far more hostile than usual. But this was Kakeru; surely he had days like that, so I answered in my usual way.

lines.japanese: 「はは、やだなあカケルくん、健忘症？　もちろん俺様ぬるっといっちゃう千歳鷲介ですコンバンワ」
lines.english: “Ha ha, don't be silly, Kakeru. Amnesia? It is I, Shusuke 'Keep It Slippery' Chitose. Good evening.”

lines.japanese: 「ふざけんなよ、なんでシュウちゃんがいるんだよ！」
lines.english: “Cut the crap! Why the hell is Shu here!?”

lines.japanese: その瞬間、ものすごい速さで伸びてきた腕に襟首を掴まれ、気が付けばカケルくんの元へ引きよせられていました。
lines.english: An arm shot out with astonishing speed and seized me by the collar. Before I knew it, Kakeru had dragged me close.

lines.japanese: 「うえっ！？　え、なに？　待って待ってカケルくん、暴力はだめよ！」
lines.english: “Ghk!? What is this? Wait, wait, Kakeru! Violence is never the answer!”

lines.japanese: わけが分かりません。
lines.english: I had no idea what was happening.

lines.japanese: 「鳳さん！　なにしてるんですか！」
lines.english: “Mr. Otori! What are you doing!?”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえ、引っこんでろ他人」
lines.english: “Shut up. This has nothing to do with you.”

lines.japanese: 見たこともないカケルくんの凄絶な眼光。さしもの日和子さんも言葉を呑んでしまう迫力です。
lines.english: I had never seen such a savage glare from Kakeru. It carried enough force to silence even Hiyoko.

lines.japanese: 俺は米田さんから聞かされた話を思いだしていました。私設自警団を束ねる悪のカリスマ。
lines.english: I remembered what Yoneda had told me: the darkly charismatic leader of a private vigilante force.

lines.japanese: 「あの、カケルくん……？　俺もしかして殴られんの？　うそん、せめて理由だけでも教えてくんない？」
lines.english: “Um, Kakeru...? Are you about to hit me? Seriously? Could you at least tell me why?”

lines.japanese: 「理由なんかねえよ。でもおまえに当たんなきゃ、俺は街中の人間、見かけた端からブン殴りそうだよ」
lines.english: “No reason. But if I don't take it out on you, I'll probably punch every person I see on the way through town.”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: 「ふざけんなよ。返せよ、換われよ、呼んでこいよ」
lines.english: “This is bullshit. Give him back. Switch out. Call him here.”

lines.japanese: 俺は抵抗もせず、されるがままになっていました。
lines.english: I offered no resistance. I let him do as he pleased.

lines.japanese: それは彼が憤っているというよりも……泣きだしそうな子どもみたいに見えたから、なのかもしれません。
lines.english: Perhaps that was because he looked less like a man consumed by rage... and more like a child on the verge of tears.

lines.japanese: 「ねえ出てきてよ、やっと逢えたのに、まさかたった一日で終わったわけじゃないよね？」
lines.english: “Please, come out. I finally found you. Don't tell me it was all over after one day.”

lines.japanese: そして、その憂える理由がなんとなく分かったから。
lines.english: I had also begun to understand what grieved him.

lines.japanese: 隼人君が≪面談≫で言っていたこと。伊丹伽楼羅という存在。伏していた長兄。
lines.english: What Hayato had said during the Interview. The existence of Karura Itami. The eldest brother who had lain dormant.

lines.japanese: カケルくんは俺の中の彼を、とても大事に思ってくれているんだ。
lines.english: Kakeru cared deeply for the person inside me.

lines.japanese: 「どうなんだよ、風を起こせばいいの？　ねえ、誰かがやったみたいに、隼人やシュウちゃんの大切なやつをやっちゃえばいいわけ？」
lines.english: “What do I have to do, stir up the wind? Should I do what somebody else did and hurt the people Hayato and Shu care about?”

lines.japanese: 「ああそう、なんだ、だったらタマイズミおまえ――」
lines.english: “Fine. I get it. In that case, Tamaizumi, you—”

lines.japanese: 「いらっしゃいませクソジャリ」
lines.english: “Welcome, you little shit.”

lines.japanese: 不意に現れたマスターが、俺を掴んでいるカケルくんをさらに掴み、自分の方へむりやり向けさせました。
lines.english: The boss appeared without warning. He seized Kakeru, who still had hold of me, and wrenched him around by force.

lines.japanese: その逆の手には、水と氷をなみなみと注いだアイスペールが握られています。そして──
lines.english: In his other hand was an ice bucket brimming with water and cubes. Then—

lines.japanese: 「頭を冷やしてさしあげましょうか、お客様」
lines.english: “Perhaps our guest would care to cool his head.”

lines.japanese: ──カケルくんの頭上にその容器をかざしました。さっきの話を聞いたあとだと、マスターの声に一層の凄みを感じます。
lines.english: —he raised it over Kakeru's head. After the story I'd heard earlier, the boss's voice carried a new and terrible weight.

lines.japanese: 「カタギ相手に牙むいてんじゃねえよ坊主。ここは俺の城だ、わきまえないなら容赦はしねえぞ」
lines.english: “Don't bare your fangs at civilians, boy. This is my castle. Step out of line and I won't show mercy.”

lines.japanese: 「やっ、やめてください店長、他のお客様の目に入ります、鳳さんも手を放して──」
lines.english: “P-please stop, Manager! The other customers can see you! And Mr. Otori, let him go—”

lines.japanese: 「ふん」
lines.english: “Hmph.”

lines.japanese: しかし日和子さんが言いおわるより先にカケルくんは腕を下ろし、力なくうなだれてしまいました。
lines.english: Before Hiyoko could finish, however, Kakeru lowered his arm and let his head droop listlessly.

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ、もう帰っちゃったのかよ……また遊ぼうって約束したじゃんか……」
lines.english: “What the hell? He's gone already...? He promised we'd play again...”

lines.japanese: 「ちくしょう、うそつき……」
lines.english: “Damn it. Liar...”

lines.japanese: 話の内容はよく分らないけど、カケルくんはよほど伽楼羅って子のことを慕っているみたいでした。
lines.english: I didn't understand all of it, but Kakeru plainly adored Karura.

lines.japanese: 隼人君の言ったとおりだ。本当に鳳翔は俺たちのことを知っていて、俺たちの知らないことも知っていて、だけど彼に知られていることを俺たちは知らなかったんだ。
lines.english: Just as Hayato had said. Kakeru Otori truly knew about us. He knew things we didn't; we simply hadn't known that he knew about us.

lines.japanese: はあ……地味にショック……。
lines.english: Haaah... That stung a little.

lines.japanese: だけど、いまはひとりで落ちこんでる場合でもないか。
lines.english: But this was hardly the time to sulk by myself.

lines.japanese: 「カケルくん、隼人君から聞いたよ。実は知ってるんだって？」
lines.english: “Kakeru, Hayato told me. You've known about us all along, haven't you?”

lines.japanese: 「まあその、なんていうかさあ……あんま遠回ししないで、直接言ってくれればよかったのに」
lines.english: “Well, I mean... You didn't have to dance around it. You could've just told me directly.”

lines.japanese: 「水くさいなあ」
lines.english: “Keeping me at arm's length like that. Some friend you are.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ」
lines.english: “Haaah.”

lines.japanese: カケルくんはマスターの氷入れからブロックアイスを一つ摘んで口の中へ放りこみました。
lines.english: Kakeru plucked an ice cube from the boss's bucket and tossed it into his mouth.

lines.japanese: ガリッ、ゴリッ。
lines.english: Crunch. Grind.

lines.japanese: 「あ、そうだ日和子さん。俺、休憩もらっちゃっていいすか」
lines.english: “Oh, right. Hiyoko, can I take my break now?”

lines.japanese: 「え……？　あ、ええはい、どうぞ……」
lines.english: “What...? Ah, yes. Certainly...”

lines.japanese: 「どもっすー。それじゃちょっと休んできますね。カケルくん、良かったら一緒にどう？」
lines.english: “Thanks. I'll be off for a bit, then. Kakeru, care to join me?”

lines.japanese: 「……マスター、３０分くらいで戻るからアメリカンよろしく」
lines.english: “...Boss, I’ll be back in about half an hour. Have a light roast ready.”

lines.japanese: 「うむ。とびきりのやつを用意しておこう」
lines.english: “Very well. I shall prepare an exceptional one.”

lines.japanese: 俺たちはひと気のない場所で話すために、店の外へ移動しました。
lines.english: We left the restaurant in search of somewhere nobody could overhear us.

lines.japanese: 「ふう」
lines.english: “Haaah.”

lines.japanese: カケルくんはわざとらしい溜息のあと、生ゴミの入ったポリバケツを軽く小突きました。
lines.english: After an ostentatious sigh, Kakeru gave a plastic trash can a light kick.

lines.japanese: いつも通りに見えるけど、あのカケルくんが物に当たるなんて相当イラついてるのかなあ。
lines.english: He looked much as ever, but if even Kakeru was taking his frustration out on things, he had to be furious.

lines.japanese: 街の不良少年たちを束ねる長身の皇帝。そんなおっそろしい男に路地裏へ呼びだされて、俺はいったい何をされるのでしょう。ええ、まあ、呼びつけたのはこっちなんですけどね。
lines.english: The towering emperor of the city's delinquents had summoned me into a back alley. What unspeakable fate awaited me now? Admittedly, I was the one who had invited him out.

lines.japanese: そんな俺の揺れうごく心情をよそに、彼は壁際に高く積まれたビールケースに足をかけました。
lines.english: Oblivious to the turmoil in my heart, he planted one foot on the beer crates stacked high against the wall.

lines.japanese: 「さあて、何から話そっかなあ」
lines.english: “Now, then. Where do I start?”

lines.japanese: ひょいと最上段へ飛びのり、高い位置から俺を見下ろします。
lines.english: He sprang lightly to the top and looked down at me from his perch.

lines.japanese: 「ああ、まだ思考がまとまんないや」
lines.english: “Nah. My thoughts are still a mess.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあこっちから質問しようか？　あのさ、キミは俺たちのことをどこまで知って――」
lines.english: “Then can I ask the questions? How much do you know about us—”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ストップ」
lines.english: “Ah. Stop.”

lines.japanese: カケルくんは上から左手を伸ばして、俺の言葉をさえぎりました。右手は額に当てて考え中のポーズ。
lines.english: Kakeru reached down with his left hand to cut me off. His right remained pressed to his forehead in a pose of deep contemplation.

lines.japanese: 「分かってるだろうけど、無闇にシュウちゃんたち自身のことは聞かない方がいいよ。あんまりいっぺんに受けいれようとして、頭バーストしちゃったら困るでしょ」
lines.english: “You probably understand this already, but you'd better not ask too many questions about yourselves. Try to take in too much at once and your head might burst. We don't want that.”

lines.japanese: 「あら、お優しい」
lines.english: “My, how considerate.”

lines.japanese: そしてお詳しい。俺はふっと息を吹きあげて前髪をふわっと浮かせました。
lines.english: And how thoroughly informed. I blew upward, lifting my bangs in a soft flutter.

lines.japanese: 「そうだなあ、まずは俺が伽楼羅と初めて会ったときのことを話そうか。知るわけないもんね、シュウちゃんや隼人は」
lines.english: “Let's see. I guess I'll start with the first time I met Karura. You and Hayato wouldn't know about that, Shu.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、分かりやすく言うと俺、けっこーヒサンな少年時代を過ごしてて」
lines.english: “To put it simply, I had a pretty horrific childhood.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、いい、いい。そこは大して重要じゃないから」
lines.english: “Oh, never mind. That part isn't very important.”

lines.japanese: 思わず顔をしかめた俺を無視して、カケルくんは話を続けました。どうやら俺ごときの凄みじゃ動じないご様子。冗談を言っているわけでもなさそうです。
lines.english: Ignoring the scowl that crossed my face, Kakeru continued. Whatever little menace I could muster did not trouble him. Nor did he seem to be joking.

lines.japanese: 「で、ある日俺は、どっかキレちゃったんだろうね。なんだったか理由はよく覚えてないけど、気付いたら目の前で、素っ裸の不細工ババアが丸くなりながら呻いてて」
lines.english: “Then one day, I guess something in me snapped. I don't remember exactly why. But when I came to, an ugly old woman was curled up naked in front of me, groaning.”

lines.japanese: 「そしたら戸籍上父親ってことになってる男に、郊外の町へ連れてかれちゃって。はは、そうだ、その前にババアきっちい拷問してくれたっけな。ああやべ、思いだしちゃった、また夢見ちゃうわ」
lines.english: “After that, the man listed as my father on the family register took me to a town out in the country. Ha ha, right. Before that, the old hag had put me through some vicious torture. Ah, hell. Now I remember. I'll dream about it again.”

lines.japanese: 「そんで俺はその田んぼだらけの町で、心身ともに休めましょうみたいなことになってたわけ。なんつったかな、あの施設……なんとかハウスみたいな名前。まあいいや、どうせシュウちゃん知ってるだろうし」
lines.english: “So there I was in that town full of rice paddies, supposedly resting both body and mind. What was that place called...? Something House. Whatever. Shu probably knows it anyway.”

lines.japanese: 俺は自分の動揺が顔に出たことを感じました。でもカケルくんは、そんなことなどまるで興味がないかのように話を続けました。
lines.english: I felt the shock show on my face. Kakeru went on as though he couldn't care less.

lines.japanese: 「つってもさあ、そんないきなり連れて来られて『はい癒されましょう』とか言われたって、知らない場所で知らない連中に囲まれて、逆にストレスは溜まる一方だっつーの」
lines.english: “But you can't just drag somebody there without warning, say, 'All right, time to heal,' and expect it to work. Strange place, strange people—it only piled on more stress.”

lines.japanese: 「でも残念ながら俺は、誰かさんと違って神経図太かったから壊れることもなくて、その軟禁所で毎んち死んだように寝てたわけ。そしたらさ、ある日すげえやつが隣りに来たんだよ」
lines.english: “Unfortunately, unlike a certain someone, I was too thick-skinned to fall apart. So every day in that little prison, I slept like the dead. Then one day, somebody incredible moved into the room next door.”

lines.japanese: カケルくんの笑顔にぞっとするような色が浮かびました。自嘲と羨望と愛憎を混ぜあわせたような、およそ見たこともない笑顔でした。
lines.english: Kakeru's smile took on a chilling cast: self-mockery, envy, love, and hatred all mixed together. I had never seen a smile like it.

lines.japanese: 「最初は呆れたね。毎んち俺の部屋の壁、ガンガン蹴りまくってくンだもん。ああアタマおかしいやつか、ぐらいに思って、しばらく放っといたんだけど」
lines.english: “At first I couldn't believe him. Every day, he'd kick the hell out of my wall. I figured he was crazy and left him alone for a while.”

lines.japanese: 「でもね、日にちが経つにつれて、壁蹴る音の合間におもしれえ話が聞こえてくんの」
lines.english: “But as the days went by, I started hearing some pretty interesting stuff between all the kicking.”

lines.japanese: 「グレタガルドとか言ってるから最初ウイクエのことかと思ってたんだけど、そのうち自分は王様で四勇者で妖術使いだとか言いだしちゃって。やっべー、こいつトビ過ぎだろって」
lines.english: “He kept saying Gretagard, so at first I thought he meant *Wing Quest*. Then he started claiming he was a king, one of four heroes, and a sorcerer. I thought, holy hell, this guy is completely gone.”

lines.japanese: 「こんな面白いやついたんだと思ったら、ちょっと興味でてきたんだけど、でもそいつほとんど軟禁されてて部屋から出ねえの。壁越しに話しかけてもガン無視だし、なんとかコンタクト取れねーかなあ思って」
lines.english: “Once I realized somebody that entertaining was next door, I got curious. But he was practically confined to his room and never came out. He ignored me when I spoke through the wall, so I started wondering how I could make contact.”

lines.japanese: 「しょーがねえから、しばらくは嘘くせえ大人に従順なふりみせて、隙さがしてたんだ。そしたら今度は、もっとすげえモン見つけちゃって！　くくっ、この感動がシュウちゃんにも分かるかなァー！」
lines.english: “I had no choice but to act obedient for the phony adults and watch for an opening. Then I found something even more incredible! Heh heh. Think you can appreciate what a thrill that was, Shu?”

lines.japanese: 彼は子供のように手足を振りみだしました。普段なら相手の調子に合わせて騒ぐはずの俺も、いまばかりは唇を結んで棒立ちするしかありませんでした。
lines.english: He flung his arms and legs about like a child. Ordinarily I would have matched his energy and made a commotion of my own. This time I could only stand rigid, lips pressed shut.

lines.japanese: 「忍びこんだ大人の部屋にさ、そいつに関する書類があったんだよ。ご丁寧に資料書籍も一緒で。それを盗み読んで、俺はそいつの名前と病名を知ったってわけ」
lines.english: “I snuck into one of the adults' rooms and found documents about him, with reference books thoughtfully left beside them. I stole a look and learned his name and diagnosis.”

lines.japanese: 「興奮したね。多重人格なんて、ほとんど物語の中のおとぎ話だと思ってたから。すげえじゃん。ずりぃよな。ヤなこと全部ばっさり切って、完全に新しい人間として生まれなおしてるなんて──」
lines.english: “I was thrilled. I'd thought multiple personalities were the stuff of fiction, practically a fairy tale. It was amazing. Almost unfair. Cutting away everything hateful and being reborn as an entirely new person—”

lines.japanese: 「──ん？　なにシュウちゃん、その目」
lines.english: “—hm? What's with that look, Shu?”

lines.japanese: 「……まあ、いいよ。言いかえしたいこと多すぎて、話の腰を折っちゃうから。こっちの言い分はまたの機会にしましょう。はい、続きどうぞ」
lines.english: “...Never mind. I have so many objections that I'd derail the whole story. I'll save my rebuttal for another time. Go on.”

lines.japanese: 「ふん、そんでね？　俺めげずにずっと話しかけてたら、なんかいつの間にか、伊丹伽楼羅の世界に割りこんじゃってたの。ある日いきなり、ガルーダの腹心フェニックスが冒険話に加えられてて超うけた」
lines.english: “Hmph. Anyway, I kept talking to him and refused to give up. Then somehow, before I knew it, I'd forced my way into Karura Itami's world. One day, Phoenix, Garuda's loyal retainer, suddenly appeared in the adventure. It was hilarious.”

lines.japanese: 「そっからは伽楼羅の話を聞くのが楽しみだったなあ。毎んち見てたおっかないババアとかの夢も、朝になれば隣りからの声で消えるようンなったし。軟禁が解けたら隠れんぼとか鬼ごっこしようって約束もしたんだ」
lines.english: “After that, I looked forward to Karura's stories. The nightmares about that terrifying old woman began fading when morning brought his voice through the wall. We even promised to play hide-and-seek and tag once they let us out.”

lines.japanese: 「なんだけど、結局それで俺は、心身ともに健やかですって診断されちゃったんだろうな。勝手に連れてこられたときと同じで、勝手に連れもどされて、さよなら伽楼羅、ちゃんちゃんってオチ」
lines.english: “But I guess that was what got me declared sound in body and mind again. Just as they'd dragged me there without asking, they dragged me back without asking. Goodbye, Karura. And that was that.”

lines.japanese: 「でも俺はずっと忘れなかったよ。嫌な方の記憶も悪夢になっていまだ俺の安眠を妨害しくさりやがるけど、うなされて飛びおきるたび、俺は泣きながら伽楼羅の名前を呼んで持ちこたえたんだ」
lines.english: “But I never forgot him. The uglier memories still come back as nightmares and fuck with my sleep. Whenever I woke sobbing, I called Karura's name and somehow held on.”

lines.japanese: 「そんで……去年の今ごろだっけ？　ぼちぼち用意も整って、興信所にあいつの行方を調べさせてたんだ。笑ったね、日払いバイトで裸Ｙシャツ喫茶の立て看板くくりつけてんだもん」
lines.english: “Then... was it around this time last year? I finally had things in place and hired a private investigator to find him. I had to laugh. There he was, working day labor with a signboard strapped to his body advertising a café where the waitresses wore dress shirts and nothing else.”

lines.japanese: 「それって……」
lines.english: “That was...”

lines.japanese: 「うん、中身はシュウちゃんだったね。すぐ確信したよ。ああこいつ、後から出来た人格なんだなって」
lines.english: “Yeah. The one inside was Shu. I knew immediately: you were a personality created later.”

lines.japanese: 「で、しばらく監視してたら、朝は羽田タカシ・夜は成田隼人って役割わけて生活してんじゃん？　おいおい伽楼羅はいつだよって話じゃん？」
lines.english: “I watched for a while and found you dividing life into shifts: Takashi Haneda by day, Hayato Narita by night. And I'm thinking, hey, when the hell does Karura get a turn?”

lines.japanese: 「監視……監視だったんだ……」
lines.english: “You watched us... So it really was surveillance...”

lines.japanese: 「そ。羽田タカシってのは、丁度チームにそいつと同級の子がいたからその子を監視役にして。シュウちゃんと隼人は俺の担当。なんかのヒントになればと思って、隼人のときは別人格のふりしたんだけど無駄だったな」
lines.english: “Right. One kid in my crew happened to be in Takashi Haneda's class, so I assigned her to watch him. Shu and Hayato were my responsibility. With Hayato, I even pretended to be another personality myself, hoping it might give him a clue. Didn't work.”

lines.japanese: 「いやあ、でもじれったかったよ。迂闊なことして存在自体おシャカになられても困るし、気長に待つしかなくてさあ。ぶっちゃけシュウちゃんや隼人に用はなかったんだけど、暇つぶしにはなったから助かったよ」
lines.english: “God, it was frustrating. I couldn't risk doing something careless and wiping him out altogether, so all I could do was wait. Frankly, I didn't care about Shu or Hayato, but you helped pass the time. I appreciated that.”

lines.japanese: 「俺さ、今になって考えてみるとさ、もともと普通の友達じゃつまんねえから、伽楼羅みたいなブッ飛んでるやつとツルみたいって思ったんだよね。自分で伽楼羅のマネなんかもしちゃってるし」
lines.english: “Looking back, I think ordinary friends had always bored me. I wanted to run with somebody completely unhinged, like Karura. I even imitate him myself sometimes.”

lines.japanese: 「でも実際、シュウちゃんも隼人もマスターも和馬もフレイムバーズのみんなも、結構バカでブッ飛んでるじゃん？　だったらべつに……」
lines.english: “But really, Shu, Hayato, the boss, Kazuma, everyone in the Flame Birds—you're all pretty stupid and unhinged too. So perhaps it doesn't have to...”

lines.japanese: 「いや……うーん、でもなあ、たぶん伽楼羅には俺しかいないんじゃないかなあ。ひとりにしたら可哀想だよね。ねえシュウちゃん、どう思う？」
lines.english: “No... Hmm. But still, I may be the only person Karura has. It'd be cruel to leave him alone. What do you think, Shu?”

lines.japanese: 「知らないよ。誰がバカでブッ飛んでるかっつーの。俺、キミの友達じゃないんだったらもう行くよ」
lines.english: “How should I know? And who are you calling stupid and unhinged? If I'm not your friend, I'm leaving.”

lines.japanese: 「ええー？　ちょっと待ってよシュウちゃん、そんなんで絶交かよ、ひっでえなあ」
lines.english: “What? Wait, Shu! You're ending our friendship over that? That's awful.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ひどくないでしょ。キミのがよっぽどひどいでしょ。なんだよ監視って」
lines.english: “No, it isn't! You're way worse! What do you mean, ‘surveillance’?”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、ごめんごめん」
lines.english: “Ha ha. Sorry, sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「軽っ！」
lines.english: “Way too casual!”

lines.japanese: いじけた子供みたいだったカケルくんは、いつの間にか穏やかな笑顔になっていました。
lines.english: Before I knew it, Kakeru had stopped looking like a sulking child and was smiling peacefully.

lines.japanese: もしかしたら、長いこと内に閉じこめていた秘密をようやく外へ漏らすことができて、少しはすっきりしたのかもしれません。
lines.english: Perhaps finally getting a secret he'd kept inside for so long off his chest had brought him some measure of relief.

lines.japanese: だとしたら、これはこれで……いいのでしょうか。
lines.english: If so, perhaps this conversation had been worthwhile after all.

lines.japanese: 誰にも言えないというのは、たとえ些細なことでも結構つらいものです。それが自分の軸ともなる大きな秘密なら尚のことでしょう。
lines.english: Being unable to tell anyone is painful enough even when the matter is small. When a secret lies at the heart of your life, the weight must be greater still.

lines.japanese: 「そんで？　カケルくんとしては今後、俺とどう付きあってくつもりなわけ」
lines.english: “So? Where does that leave you and me?”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？　なにそれ。どうって、べつに」
lines.english: “Huh? What kind of question is that? Nothing in particular.”

lines.japanese: 「べつにかよ！」
lines.english: “Nothing in particular!?”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃそうじゃん。まだ伽楼羅の出てくる可能性が完全になくなったわけじゃないでしょ？　だったら今まで通り監視続けるだけだし」
lines.english: “Obviously. Karura could still show up, right? So I'll just keep watching you like I always have.”

lines.japanese: 「ストーカー継続宣言！」
lines.english: “And there it is: a formal declaration that the stalking will continue!”

lines.japanese: 「ええ？　シュウちゃんはめんどくさいなあ。じゃあいいよ、監視って言葉が気に入らないならトモダチで」
lines.english: “What? Shu, you're such a pain. Fine. If you don't like the word 'surveillance,' we can call it being friends.”

lines.japanese: カケルくんはビールケースの玉座からぴょんと飛びおりました。
lines.english: Kakeru hopped down from his throne of beer crates.

lines.japanese: 「ねえシュウちゃん、こんど遊ぶときは合コンじゃなくて、鬼ごっことか隠れんぼでもしようよ」
lines.english: “Hey, Shu. Next time we hang out, forget the group date. Let's play tag or hide-and-seek.”

lines.japanese: 「え？　ええ？」
lines.english: “What? Really?”

lines.japanese: 「なあーんてね。嘘だよ」
lines.english: “Juuust kidding. That was a lie.”

lines.japanese: 「ははっ」
lines.english: “Ha!”

lines.japanese: 子供みたいなことを言うカケルくんに、軽く吹きだしてしまいました。
lines.english: His childish suggestion made me laugh.

lines.japanese: なあんだ。一年越しの謎が解けた気がしました。
lines.english: Well, then. I felt as though a year-old mystery had finally been solved.

lines.japanese: そうじゃないかとは思ってたけど、結局のとこカケルくんってやっぱ、俺やみんなと遊びたいだけだったんじゃん。
lines.english: I'd suspected as much, but in the end Kakeru really had only wanted to play with me and everybody else.

lines.japanese: 「うん、いいね鬼ごっこ。出来るだけ人数集めて、柳木原中でパァーッとやろう」
lines.english: “Sure, tag sounds great. We'll round up as many people as we can and play all over Yanagihara.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？　何それ、本気で言ってんの」
lines.english: “What? Are you actually serious?”

lines.japanese: とか言いながらも、決して否定はしないカケルくん。
lines.english: Yet for all his protests, Kakeru never said no.

lines.japanese: これからも長い付き合いになりそうです。今後ともよろしく。
lines.english: It looked as though we'd be stuck with each other for years. Fine by me.

lines.japanese: 「まあ、人数合わせならフレイムバーズ召集して……ああ、カラスんとこの信者も来させるか」
lines.english: “Well, for numbers, I could call in the Flame Birds... Oh, and have Crow bring his followers.”

lines.japanese: なんかよく分かんないけど、静かに闘志を燃やしてました。
lines.english: I didn't quite follow, but a quiet competitive fire had lit within him.
“Ah.”

lines.japanese: 正面入り口へまわったころになって、ふと気付きました。
lines.english: Only when we rounded the building toward the main entrance did something occur to me.

lines.japanese: 「もしかしてさっきのフレイムなんたらって、まさか……」
lines.english: “Those Flame-whatevers you just mentioned... Don't tell me they're...”

lines.japanese: 米田さんの言っていたガラの悪い青少年たち……？
lines.english: The rough-looking youths Yoneda had described...?

lines.japanese: 「ん？　フレイムバーズがどうかした？」
lines.english: “Hm? What about the Flame Birds?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ちょっと小耳に挟んだんだけど、カケルくんさあ、もういい大人なんだからあんまりファンキーな遊びは控えた方がいいんじゃない？」
lines.english: “I happened to hear a little about them. Kakeru, you're a grown man now. Shouldn't you tone down the wild stunts?”

lines.japanese: 「あれはもうやめたよ」
lines.english: “I quit that already.”

lines.japanese: 「いいから黙って聞きなさいって。あのね、米田さんだって心配してたし、引いては俺のクビにも関わええええええウソやめたの！？　いつ！？」
lines.english: “Never mind that, just listen. Yoneda was worried too, and my job could end up on the liiiiiine—wait, you quit!? When!?”

lines.japanese: 「きのう。なんで？　なんか問題あった？」
lines.english: “Yesterday. Why? Was there a problem?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そ、そう……いや、やめてくれたなら問題ないんだけど……え、なんで？」
lines.english: “Oh. I-I see... No, if you quit, there's no problem... But why?”

lines.japanese: 「だってアレは昔、伽楼羅に兵を集めとけって言われたから、あいつのために用意したんだもん。みんなでサバイバルゲームとかしたら面白そうかなって思って」
lines.english: “Because years ago, Karura told me to gather soldiers. I formed it for him. I thought it might be fun to get everyone together for a huge airsoft war.”

lines.japanese: 「なのに、シュウちゃんが出てるせいで、伽楼羅が出てこらんないわけでしょ。そんじゃもう意味ないじゃん」
lines.english: “But Shu being out is what keeps Karura from coming out, right? Then there's no point anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「え、それ俺のせいなの……？」
lines.english: “Wait, that's my fault...?”

lines.japanese: 「一因はあるよね。ふぁ～あ、コーヒー飲も」
lines.english: “You had something to do with it. Yaaawn. Let's have coffee.”

lines.japanese: カケルくんは大きく伸びをしながらすたすた店へ入っていきました。
lines.english: Kakeru stretched his arms overhead and strode back into the restaurant.

lines.japanese: し、知らなかった……俺、いつの間にか、米田さんからの頼みを解決してしまっていたのか。
lines.english: I-I had no idea... At some point, without even realizing it, I'd fulfilled Yoneda's request.

lines.japanese: めでたしめでたし？
lines.english: And they all lived happily ever after?

lines.japanese: 首をひねりながらアレキサンダーへ戻りました。
lines.english: Still trying to make sense of it, I went back inside.

lines.japanese: それから三十分ほどして、アレキサンダーに複数名のお客さんが来店しました。
lines.english: About half an hour later, several customers entered Alexander.

lines.japanese: 「い、いらっしゃいませ、三名様でしょうか」
lines.english: “W-welcome. A party of three?”

lines.japanese: <10>\「かっけるくーん、あっそびっましょー！」
lines.english: “Kakeruuu! Come out and plaaay!”

lines.japanese: いかにもやんちゃな悪ガキ風のお客様方は、鳳翔そのひとの名を呼びながらまっすぐ彼の席へと向かいます。
lines.english: The guests looked every inch a pack of unruly little hoodlums. Calling Kakeru Otori by name, they marched straight toward his table.

lines.japanese: たまたま俺は近くの席の片付け作業中だったため、彼らのやたら大きな声が嫌でも耳に入ってしまいます。
lines.english: I happened to be clearing a nearby table, so I couldn't help overhearing their booming voices.

lines.japanese: 「翔さーん、な～に一人でコーヒー飲んでんスか、そんなら俺らも呼んでくださいよ！」
lines.english: “Kakeru! What're you doing drinking coffee all by yourself? You should've called us!”

lines.japanese: 「なんで。だって俺、もうＹＦＢと関係ないもん」
lines.english: “Why? I'm not part of the YFB anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「なーに、寂しいこと言ってんスか！　チームとか関係なく、自分ら鳳チルドレンっスよ！」
lines.english: “Aw, don't say something so lonely! Team or no team, we're still your boys!”

lines.japanese: どうやら例のフレイムなんたら言う、元お仲間さんでしょうか。まだまだカケルくんに御執心のよう。
lines.english: These appeared to be his former comrades in those Flame-whatevers. They remained utterly devoted to Kakeru.

lines.japanese: それに対して冷えきった態度のカケルくん。
lines.english: Kakeru met their devotion with glacial indifference.

lines.japanese: 「知らないって。コーヒーなら三人で飲みなよ。つーか、なんも注文しないなら帰れば？」
lines.english: “Don't know what you're talking about. The three of you can drink coffee together. Actually, if you're not ordering anything, why don't you leave?”

lines.japanese: 「イェア！　そりゃアンタの言うとおりだぜ、俺らもちょうど飢えてたところさ。おいおい、そこのイカしたねーちゃん、ニュージャージーを思いだす極上ビッグなビーフとコーラを一緒に頼むぜ」
lines.english: “Yeah! The man speaks truth—we're starving. Yo, fine lady! Bring me your biggest, baddest hunk of beef, New Jersey style, and a Coke!”

lines.japanese: 「ち、千歳さん！　千歳さんの方が近いのに、なんでわざわざ私を呼ぶんですかあのお客さん！」
lines.english: “M-Mr. Chitose! You're closer than I am! Why did that customer go out of his way to call me!?”

lines.japanese: 「さ、さあ、俺に言われても……や、でも、見かけのわりに害はなさそうっすよ彼ら」
lines.english: “H-how should I know...? Still, appearances aside, they seem harmless enough.”

lines.japanese: 「サーセン自分、大盛りミートパスタとアイスティーで！　ちゅーか自分思うんスけどお、あの、ジャスミン的なアイスティーとかアレ何なんスか。アレぶっちゃけ歯磨き味じゃねースか」
lines.english: “'Scuuuse me! I'll take the jumbo meat pasta and an iced tea! But, like, here's what I'm thinkin'—um, what's the deal with that jasmine-type iced tea stuff? Doesn't it straight-up taste like toothpaste?”

lines.japanese: 「そうよね～、ハーブっちゅったら、もっとブリンブリンにキマっちゃうタバコ的なハーブが欲しいよね～」
lines.english: “Right? When you say herb, I want the smokable kind that gets you stupid high.”

lines.japanese: 「あの……申しわけございません、法に触れるメニューはご用意いたしかねます」
lines.english: “Um... My apologies, but we are unable to offer anything prohibited by law.”

lines.japanese: 「ああん？　綺麗事ぬかしてねーで、はよ頼まれたもん持ってこいや腐れヌンコ」
lines.english: “Huh? Cut the moralizing and bring them what they ordered already, you rotten nunt.”

lines.japanese: 「ぎゃっはっは、さすがは皇帝、まだまだ爪は切りおとしてねえ！　いいぜえ、あんたのイカれたディスをもっともっと聞かせてくれよ！」
lines.english: “Gyaa ha ha! That's our Emperor—his claws haven't been clipped yet! Hell yes! Keep those psycho disses coming!”

lines.japanese: 「だから、俺もう皇帝じゃないんだって」
lines.english: “I told you. I'm not the Emperor anymore.”

lines.japanese: 「ＯＫマイメン、そしたらあんたの卒業記念にみんなで大統領のカミさんでもマワしに行こうぜ！　もっともあんたのジミーちゃんは、程度の知れたションベン女じゃ、ちっとも奮いたたねえかもな」
lines.english: “Okay, my man! Then to celebrate your graduation, let's all go run a train on the president's wife! Though some second-rate piss-broad may not be enough to rouse your little Jimmy.”

lines.japanese: 「むぁ～じスか！　したら俺ッ、俺俺、代わりに俺いただきます！」
lines.english: “Are you seeerious!? Then I'll—I'll take her off your hands!”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、ここは最年長の俺が」
lines.english: “Now, now. As the eldest, that honor surely belongs to me.”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、ここは間をとって俺が」
lines.english: “Now, now. Let's split the difference and say me.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせーなあ……腐れヌンコが睨んでるから声しぼれよ」
lines.english: “You're too damn loud... The rotten nunt is glaring at us, so keep it down.”

lines.japanese: つい微笑みが漏れてしまいました。
lines.english: I couldn't help smiling.

lines.japanese: なんだ、カケルくん、友達いるんじゃん。
lines.english: So Kakeru did have friends after all.

lines.japanese: さて、ひとのことばかり構ってないで、俺もあとひと踏ん張り労働しましょうかね。
lines.english: Enough worrying about everyone else. Time for one last stretch of work.

lines.japanese: 体をコキコキ鳴らしながら持ち場へ向かいました。
lines.english: Cracking my joints, I returned to my station.
